$description: Theme overrides for component tokens — only for decisions that genuinely differ between light and dark. Anything identical in both themes belongs in src/tokens/component/.

background.$description: The dark outline fill: a translucent wash of the control boundary, a quiet lift over whatever it sits on (canvas, card or overlay). This is the foundation-pass `dark:bg-input/12`, moved into a token so the variant carries no theme patch.

thumb.$description: The off thumb: the light inverse surface on the control-grey track. It inverts to the graphite thumb-checked when on, so dark mode keeps the same light-off / graphite-on reading as light mode.

background.$description: The dark writing surface: a translucent recessed well, a step below whatever surface the field sits on (canvas, card or overlay), so it reads as a slot to type into rather than a lifted grey slab. The ≥3:1 control boundary carries the affordance.

background-disabled.$description: A disabled dark field loses its well and fades with opacity-disabled, so it reads as unavailable without becoming a lighter grey block.
